Model 2 (T2), in contrast, perfectly captured the 'very fast pace'. Its delivery was significantly quicker, almost breathless, which is exactly what one would expect from someone in a great hurry. The words were slightly clipped and ran together, a natural characteristic of very fast human speech, which made the performance more authentic and aligned with the prompt. The overall effect was one of genuine urgency and rush.

The difference in performance is significant. Model 2's interpretation of 'very fast' was more literal and intense, making it a superior execution of the user's command compared to Model 1's more moderately fast approach.
